text:
Sara L: FYI — multiple CI jobs in staging started failing after we rotated the runner service account. getting 403 when trying to impersonate. can someone triage?

deploy-bot: Automated alert: 5 failed deploy jobs in last 10m (staging). Error sample: `403: Permission 'iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken' denied` :warning:

Mike T: can you paste the job log and the exact gcloud command the runner uses to impersonate?

Sara L: log snippet below — redacted project ids.
```
+ gcloud iam service-accounts impersonate --impersonate-service-account=ci-runner@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com --format=json
ERROR: (gcloud) PermissionError: 403 Forbidden: iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken denied for serviceAccount:ci-runner@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com
Job: gitlab-runner-42 build #987
```

Ivana P: sounds like the new SA lost the iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken binding either on the target SA or the runner's GCE instance service account. Did the rotation also change the 'allowed to impersonate' principals?

Sara L: rotation was supposed to be just key rotation via KMS. we did switch the SA principal during the process because we created a new ephemeral SA and planned a cutover. maybe missed the iam.policy binding.

Mike T: quick repro steps for us: 1) on a box with gcloud auth as runner identity run `gcloud auth print-access-token --impersonate-service-account=ci-runner@...` 2) observe 403. if that reproduces, check `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy ci-runner@...` to confirm `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` principal entries.

Sara L: repro confirmed: `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy` shows the old runner instance SA is not listed. only group:ci-ops@redwood.com is present.

Ivana P: aha — the runner instances expect the instance SA (or runner service account) to have `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` on the target ci-runner SA. If you replaced the SA resource without copying IAM bindings, impersonation will be denied. Two fixes: restore binding for the instance SA, or add a short-lived binding and run rollout.

oncall: note — this pattern also trips when token TTL is shorter than the runner's impersonation window. check the runner token cache TTL vs. the impersonated token TTL (e.g., runner caches credentials for 60s while cloud issues 30s tokens) — leads to spurious 403s after rotation.

Sara L: good call — our runner config caches tokens for 90s. cloud minted tokens were 60s on the new SA by default. after rotation there are token overlap windows where cached token became invalid.

Mike T: recommended immediate remediation: 1) re-add `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` for the runner instance SA on the ci-runner SA for staging; 2) increase impersonated token TTL to at least 120s if possible; 3) reduce runner cache TTL to 30s temporarily while rollout completes.

Ivana P: commands to patch IAM quickly (requires org admin):
```
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding ci-runner@redwood-staging.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --member="serviceAccount:projects/-/serviceAccounts/runner-instance-sa@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com" \
  --role="roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator" --project=redwood-staging
```

Sara L: applying binding now, will restart a couple runners and re-run the failed job. will follow up with results. :crossed_fingers:

deploy-bot: Job retry queued: staging/#987 retry-1 by Sara L

Sara L: quick update — adding the binding fixed it for 3 retried jobs, one other job failed with the token-cache race; I reduced runner cache and retried — success.

Mike T: long-term: add this to runbook for SA rotation: checklist item to copy IAM bindings or script `get-iam-policy | set-iam-policy` for migrations, and confirm token TTL/caching windows. also consider using short-lived workload identity where possible to avoid manual impersonation bindings.

Ivana P: filing a small alert rule in Console to detect `iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken denied` patterns during SA rotations so ops get a heads-up.

Sara L: thanks all — closing ticket after verifying a few more jobs. will post the runbook changes in #eng-infra once ready. :white_check_mark:
